description: Directly evaluated (not tabulated) reference values for the Zodiacally ephemeris tables, generated by tools/ephemeris-build/build.py. jd: TT; value: deg; rate: deg/day (five-point difference, h = 0.01 d); fitErrorBoundArcsec: upper bound of |table - value| at jd (verified record maximum or the actual error, whichever is larger). kind "conjunction": epochs where a single 16-day polynomial was worst, evaluated through the refined sub-records.
